morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为外语专名整体处理，无马来语词缀。俄语内部可分析为 Denis + -ovich，表示男性父称；这不是马来语构词。所列音标为俄语来源读音。

senses.zh_definition: 杰尼索维奇：俄语男性父称，意为“杰尼斯之子”；见于伊万·杰尼索维奇等人名。
senses.en_definition: Denisovich, a Russian masculine patronymic meaning “son of Denis,” occurring in names such as Ivan Denisovich.
senses.ms_definition: Patronimik lelaki Rusia yang bermaksud anak lelaki kepada Denis, seperti dalam nama Ivan Denisovich.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正文应写 Denisovich；数据包中的小写形式仅保留作词头。它在 Ivan Denisovich 中是父称，不能直接当作姓氏。数据包未提供DBP释义，本条马来文为编写释义；status 为所要求的数据标签，不代表此专名已获DBP普通词收录认证。[普希金俄语学院：父称](https://ls.pushkininstitute.ru/lsslovar/?title=Отчество/B1-B2)。

etymology.historical_story: Denisovich belongs to the Russian patronymic system, which identifies a person through the father's given name. Readers encounter it in Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn's One Day in the Life of Ivan Denisovich, published in November 1962. The title pairs Ivan's given name with his patronymic, bringing an ordinary prisoner's personal identity into the foreground. [Solzhenitsyn Center](https://www.solzhenitsyncenter.org/one-day-in-the-life-of-ivan-denisovich).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Denis + ovich → Denis 的儿子：先记住父亲叫 Denis，再把 -ovich 看作男性父称标记；这只是俄语分析。
